title: Need for Speed II: Special Edition
notes: Vault reads the game's record tables (FeData\pc\stats) and never touches the game.
A record counts as yours when it carries your driver name from the game's options. Records you already hold count too.

testGuide.title: Set a record
testGuide.detail: Race any track and finish with a time good enough for its top 10. The track's "On the Board" achievement should pop.

testGuide.title: Check the numbers
testGuide.detail: "Your driver names" should show the name you race under.
